notes.title: 🚀 Sneak Peek: What’s Coming in Dream World’s Next Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Dream World adventurers! 🌟[/b]

Our next big update is just around the corner, and while we’re still making final adjustments, we wanted to give you a glimpse of what’s coming. This isn’t the full patch list—expect official patch notes closer to launch—but here are some key highlights to get excited about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/db49e73e9f3c4cf8b0bb15d1dfd53e4e00aa6975.png[/img]

[b]🔥 What’s in Development?[/b]
🏹 Mob Refactor – Smarter Enemies & Better Combat
We’re continuing to refine enemy behavior, making combat more dynamic, responsive, and strategic.

✅ Improved combat logic – Enemies will move and attack more intelligently.
✅ Better world destruction mechanics – Environments react more realistically during battles.
✅ Multiplayer replication improvements – Smoother AI behavior in co-op play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/0cab4b469e3f56368d3858c58abb577e635d8eba.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Confirmed: Full Controller Support![/b]
We’re happy to confirm that full controller support is coming in this update! Gamepad players will enjoy seamless input, improved UI navigation, and better responsiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/26090dcb527808757fc75c947d36ab9b2b528731.gif[/img]

[b]🏙 Performance Optimizations & Area Protection Fixes[/b]
This update also includes major performance improvements, especially for large cities and multiplayer environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/541066b5a192edd3b928eba06b079b7e0b7ebb88.png[/img]

✅ City performance optimizations – Faster load times & improved FPS.
✅ Area Protector System Fixes – Bug fixes and general stability improvements.
✅ Secondary Drop System Tweaks – More balanced and dynamic loot distribution.

📌 Until then, make sure to [b]follow and wishlist DreamWorld [/b]so you don’t miss anything!

notes.title: Final Days for DreamWorld Playtest Access!
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers! 🎮

The DreamWorld Playtest is nearing its next big milestone! [b]Starting Monday, December 2nd, we’ll no longer allow new players to join the playtest.[/b] If you haven’t already, download the game on Steam and log in before then!

For players who created an account prior to [b]December 2nd[/b], you’ll still have access to the game until we prepare for our next major release. [b]Don’t worry—your builds, resources, and items will carry over to future versions of DreamWorld![/b]

As part of this transition, the current playtest will be removed from Steam libraries ahead of our 2025 DreamWorld release. To ensure you don’t miss out, make sure to [b]“ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST”[/b] and [b]“FOLLOW”[/b] our Steam Page

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103280/DreamWorld_The_Infinite_Sandbox_MMO/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210421/48f6264422194034dfb4499f2695465c33c50395.png[/img][/url]

Don’t forget—our [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend]Refer a Friend Program[/url] is also ending on December 2nd, so invite your friends and earn rewards while you still can. After that date, new players will need a Steam Key to join. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3103280/view/4548165155602563630]Learn more[/url]

Have questions? Reach out to us anytime on [url=https://discord.gg/playdreamworld]Discord[/url] ou email us [url=support@playdreamworld.com ]support@playdreamworld.com [/url]

Thank you for helping make DreamWorld amazing! ❤️

notes.title: DreamWorld Referral Program – Invite Friends & Earn Rewards! 🎁
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers!

We’re thrilled to introduce the [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend]DreamWorld Referral Program[/url], where you can earn rewards by inviting friends to play DreamWorld! 

[h3][b]Here’s how it works:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend][b]Sign up on Gleam[/b][/url]
Visit our Gleam page here and sign up using your email. Connect your Steam account to activate the referral tracking system.
[*] [b]Play DreamWorld on Steam:[/b]
If you haven’t already, request access to play DreamWorld on Steam and dive into the infinite world of adventure. This step is required to unlock your referral link.
[*] [b]Generate Your Referral Link:[/b]
Once you’ve connected your Steam account, click on the “Refer Friends” button on the Gleam page. You’ll receive a unique referral link that you can start sharing immediately.
[*] [b]Share Your Link Everywhere:[/b]
Post your link on social media, share it in gaming groups, or send it directly to friends. The more you share, the more chances you have to earn points!
[*] [b]Earn Points for Successful Referrals:[/b]
For every friend who signs up using your link and plays at least once, you’ll earn +10 points. Remember, your friend must play at least once for the referral to count.
[*] [b]Redeem Your Rewards:[/b]
For every 100 points (equivalent to 10 successful referrals), you’ll receive a $10 Amazon gift card! Points are automatically tracked, and rewards are sent to the email you registered with Gleam every Friday.
[/olist]

[b]This Event runs until November 15th.[/b]

Want to learn more about how to maximize your rewards? [url=https://www.playdreamworld.com/blogpost/bbbeb6e1-d832-420f-af82-5073df9bba6d]Read the full blog post here![/url]

Every referral counts! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out on Discord or email  support@playdreamworld.com


Stay awesome, keep dreaming, and see you online! 🪐✨

notes.title: HallowDream Building Competition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/2d3cf571b50ab15696e2c6c958a1f9795558e529.jpg[/img]

Calling all Dreamers! 🏰🦄 Now that DreamWorld Steam Playtest access is fully open, it's time to show off your building skills and creativity in the HallowDream Build Contest! Get ready to create haunted houses, spooky mansions, or eerie castles using the DreamForge tool and earn exclusive rewards! 👻🎨

[h1]How to Participate:[/h1]
1. Build: Use DreamForge to create your haunted structure and decorate it with your spooky 3D assets. 🎃👻

2. Submit: Log into DreamWorld, take a screenshot of your creation by pressing C in-game, and it will automatically upload to the DreamShots channel in our official Discord. If you REALLY want to impress your fellow Dreamers, and earn more votes, you may also record a video of your build and post it there as well. (Add #HallowDream2024 in the Description to Enter)

3. Vote/Share: On October 31st we will curate the best submissions and make a post for people to vote on the winners. Be sure to share the posts with all your friends to get the most votes!


[h1]🏆 Prizes Include:[/h1]
- Grand Prize: A unique Unicorn Mount and Magical Unicorn Pet for the top-voted creation.
- Top 10 Participants: Each will receive the Magical Unicorn Pet as a reward!
- All Participants: Everyone who submits a DreamShot will get 20 Dream Essence to help with their spooky builds! 🏗️💀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/bfedc1fddf7ee8a60c796b858aa76a0b8af8ea2f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Important Dates:[/h1]
- Contest starts: October 18, 2024, 3 PM PDT
- Submission deadline: October 31, 2024
- Winners announced: November 8, 2024 (Live on stream)

[h2]👉 Join the contest now: Discord DreamShots Channel [/h2]
https://discord.gg/playdreamworld


[h2]👾 Play DreamWorld on Steam: Download Now[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103280/DreamWorld_The_Infinite_Sandbox_MMO/


[h2]📣 Share your builds on TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube Shorts to recruit more voters![/h2]


Thank you all so much for participating, we are really excited to see you build the most haunted mansions DreamWorld has ever seen! 💀🎃👑

notes.title: Create Anything with Text-to-3D Model Generation in DreamWorld
notes.content:
It’s time to unveil one of our major features in the upcoming Steam release, AI Text-to-3D Model generation! 

Please check out this video announcement, and help us spread the word by liking and sharing. This feature goes live for our free Steam Playtest October 10th!
https://youtu.be/-sMeJndFdKI

We’re really excited about this feature, as it’s been part of our vision since DreamWorld’s inception to allow players to create and build with their own 3D models. We hope to expand this feature in the future to support players uploading their own models from sources like Blender, and even adding movement, animations, and functionality to models.

Please note that we’re still developing replication for these AI assets, so for this playtest, each player will only be able to see their own generated assets. We hope to have replication supported in the next few months!

This AI feature was developed in partnership with Meshy (https://www.meshy.ai/). This tool is a simple way for you all to create their own 3D models, but we’re still making DreamWorld’s 3D models using a traditional art pipeline.

Would love for you to join our upcoming Steam Playtest October 10th. Just visit our Steam Page and click “Request Access”

As always, reach out on Discord https://discord.gg/tEDQUK28x4 with any questions. We look forward to seeing you in DreamWorld!

notes.title: DreamWorld's Steam Playtest Coming October 10th
notes.content:
DreamWorld is officially launching our first Steam Playtest, Thursday October 10th!!!

To sign up, just scroll down on our Steam Page and click “Request Access”. We will be letting a limited number of players in starting October 10th. This free playtest will be live for a month, and possibly extended further.

You will receive an email from Steam when you have been admitted. Be sure to reserve your spot now!!! To be notified of updates on Steam, please also “Add to Wishlist” and “Follow”.

As part of this launch, we will no longer support DreamWorld from our native launcher. All releases for the foreseeable future will be on Steam.

As always, free to ask us any questions here in Discussions, or in our Discord Channel:
https://discord.gg/btxHUQe8ZH


Please tell all your friends to sign up as well, we want to make this DreamWorld launch as big as possible!
